archimate:BusinessActor.name: data custodian
archimate:BusinessActor.documentation:
responsible for the technical implementation, maintenance, and safekeeping of data. how data is stored, transported, and protected based on rules set by the business the technical infrastructure to enforce data policies and keep data safe
Key Responsibilities of a Data Custodian: 1. implementing access controls (such as role-based access) to ensure only authorized users can view or modify the data. 2. Enforcing encryption protocols for data both at rest and in transit. 3. ensuring the structural health of the databases, servers, or cloud environments where data lives. 4. Monitoring data pipelines to ensure data isn't corrupted, lost, or degraded during transmission. 5. Lifecycle Management & disaster recovery
